items.title: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
items.summary: Nvidia just released a free speech-to-text model that can transcribe up to 40 languages, but it only works on recordings, not live audio, so it’s a big step for meeting and medical transcription tools while still leaving real-time use to rivals like ElevenLabs.

items.title: FADU wants to take the CPU out of AI storage by putting the file system inside the SSD, but the proof won't arrive until 2027
items.summary: FADU's new SSD runs its own file system, so GPUs and DPUs can read files without CPU intervention, but samples won't land until Q3 2027.

items.title: Nvidia wants to turn old nuclear power plants into huge AI data centers — but says it draws the line at turning them back on
items.summary: Nvidia and PreussenElektra are assessing Germany's retired nuclear sites for AI data centers, without restarting reactors or committing to construction.

items.title: Adam Mosseri says negativity around AI is ‘going to get worse’
items.summary: Asked about AI and the trend of college students booing tech CEOs at graduation ceremonies, Instagram head Adam Mosseri acknowledged in an interview that a lot of people really don't like AI, and it's not just young people and creatives. items.title: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
items.summary: The announcement came alongside parent company Alphabet's third-quarter earnings report, which saw revenue grow 25% year over year to $127.6 billion.

items.title: Should you buy a MacBook Pro now? M6, touchscreen and older models compared
items.summary: Macworld Apple has launched an M6 MacBook Pro alongside a new touchscreen MacBook Pro with M5 Pro and M5 Max chips . If you’re buying your first MacBook Pro or replacing an older model, now is a good time to consider your options – although we recommend reading independent reviews before committing.

items.title: Microsoft hits 10 quarters of record-breaking revenue in a row
items.summary: Whatever the future of AI might be, the current situation is still very good for Microsoft. The tech giant reported yet another record for quarterly revenue on Wednesday: $92.3 billion, a 19% increase over the year-ago quarter.

items.title: Google says its investments in AI are driving more searches
items.summary: Google parent company Alphabet says that its AI investments are leading to a big growth in searches year-over-year, as noted in its Q3 2026 earnings today.
